arxiv-2104-04419.title: Exponential Decay of Mutual Information for Gibbs states of local Hamiltonians
arxiv-2104-04419.creator: Andreas Bluhm, Ángela Capel, Antonio Pérez-Hernández
arxiv-2104-04419.description: Abstract The thermal equilibrium properties of physical systems can be described using Gibbs states. It is therefore of great interest to know when such states allow for an easy description. In particular, this is the case if correlations between distant regions are small. In this work, we consider 1D quantum spin systems with local, finite-range, translation-invariant interactions at any temperature.

arxiv-2104-12926.title: Neuromimetic Control — A Linear Model Paradigm
arxiv-2104-12926.creator: John Baillieul & Zexin Sun
arxiv-2104-12926.description: Abstract Stylized models of the neurodynamics that underpin sensory motor control in animals are proposed and studied. The voluntary motions of animals are typically initiated by high level intentions created in the primary cortex through a combination of perceptions of the current state of the environment along with memories of past reactions to similar states.

arxiv-2206-01787.title: Turbulent magnetic field in the H ii region Sh 2 − - 27
arxiv-2206-01787.creator: N. C. Raycheva, M. Haverkorn, S. Ideguchi, J. M. Stil, B. M. Gaensler, X. Sun, J. L. Han, E. Carretti, X. Y. Gao, T. Wijte
arxiv-2206-01787.description: Abstract Context. Magnetic fields in the turbulent interstellar medium (ISM) are a key element in understanding Galactic dynamics, but there are many observational challenges. One useful probe for studying the magnetic field component parallel to the line of sight (LoS) is Faraday rotation of linearly polarized radio synchrotron emission, combined with H α \alpha observations.

arxiv-2207-13082.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning at Multiple Frequencies
arxiv-2207-13082.creator: Kaylee Burns, Tianhe Yu, Chelsea Finn, Karol Hausman
arxiv-2207-13082.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kaylee Burns, Tianhe Yu, Chelsea Finn, Karol Hausman. Leveraging many sources of offline robot data requires grappling with the heterogeneity of such data. In this paper, we focus on one particular aspect of heterogeneity: learning from offline data collected at different control frequencies. Across labs, the discretization of controllers, sampling rates of sensors, and demands of a task of interest may differ, giving rise to a mixture of frequencies in an aggregated dataset.

arxiv-2208-02546.title: Observational Signatures of Massive Black Hole Progenitor Pathways: Could Leo I be a Smoking Gun? 2022 Observational Signatures of Massive Black Hole Progenitor Pathways: Could Leo I be a Smoking Gun? – References
arxiv-2208-02546.creator: John A. Regan, Fabio Pacucci & M. J. Bustamante-Rosell
arxiv-2208-02546.description: Abstract Observational evidence is mounting regarding the population demographics of Massive Black Holes (MBHs), from the most massive cluster galaxies down to the dwarf galaxy regime. However, the progenitor pathways from which these central MBHs formed remain unclear. Here we report a potentially powerful observational signature of MBH formation in dwarf galaxies.

arxiv-2405-11615.title: Approximation of bivariate densities with compositional splines
arxiv-2405-11615.creator: Stanislav Škorňa, Jitka Machalová, Jana Burkotová, Karel Hron, Sonja Greven
arxiv-2405-11615.description: Abstract Reliable estimation and approximation of probability density functions is fundamental for their further processing. However, their specific properties, i.e. scale invariance and relative scale, prevent the use of standard methods of spline approximation and have to be considered when building a suitable spline basis.

arxiv-2502-05612.title: Rambler in the Wild: A Diary Study of LLM-Assisted Writing With Speech
arxiv-2502-05612.creator: Xuyu Yang, Wengxi Li, Matthew G. Lee, Zhuoyang Li, J.D. Zamfirescu-Pereira, Can Liu
arxiv-2502-05612.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xuyu Yang, Wengxi Li, Matthew G. Lee, Zhuoyang Li, J.D. Zamfirescu-Pereira, Can Liu. Speech-to-text technologies have been shown to improve text input efficiency and potentially lower the barriers to writing. Recent LLM-assisted dictation tools aim to support writing with speech by bridging the gaps between speaking and traditional writing. This case study reports on the real-world writing experiences of twelve academic or creative writers using one such tool, Rambler, to write various pieces such as blog posts, diaries, screenplays, notes, or fictional stories, etc.

arxiv-2502-10939.title: Model-assisted inference for dynamic causal effects in staggered rollout cluster randomized experiments
arxiv-2502-10939.creator: Xinyuan Chen, Fan Li
arxiv-2502-10939.description: Abstract Staggered rollout cluster randomized experiments (SR-CREs) involve sequential treatment adoption across clusters, requiring analysis methods that address a general class of dynamic causal effects, anticipation, and non-ignorable cluster-period sizes. Without imposing any outcome modeling assumptions, we study regression estimators using individual data, cluster-period averages, and scaled cluster-period totals, with and without covariate adjustment from a design-based perspective.

arxiv-2506-24020.title: Phase-Space Topology in a Single-Atom Synthetic Dimension
arxiv-2506-24020.creator: Kyungmin Lee, Sunkyu Yu, Seungwoo Yu, Jiyong Kang, Wonhyeong Choi, Daun Chung, Sumin Park, Taehyun Kim
arxiv-2506-24020.description: Abstract We investigate topological features in the synthetic Fock-state lattice of a single-atom system described by the quantum Rabi model. By diagonalizing the Hamiltonian, we identify a zero-energy defect state localized at a domain wall of the synthetic lattice, whose spin polarization is topologically protected.

arxiv-2511-17479.title: Emergence of Randomness in Temporally Aggregated Financial Tick Sequences
arxiv-2511-17479.creator: Silvia Onofri, Andrey Shternshis, Stefano Marmi 1. Scuola Normale Superiore, Piazza dei Cavalieri 7, Pisa, Italy, 561262. Uppsala University, Regementsvägen 10, Uppsala, Sweden, 75105
arxiv-2511-17479.description: Abstract Markets efficiency implies that the stock returns are intrinsically unpredictable, a property that makes markets comparable to random number generators. We present a novel methodology to investigate ultra-high frequency financial data and to evaluate the extent to which tick by tick returns resemble random sequences.

arxiv-2512-06584.title: Probing Cosmic Magnetism with Rotation Measure-Squared-Galaxy Cross-Correlations
arxiv-2512-06584.creator: and Adam Lidz
arxiv-2512-06584.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by and Adam Lidz. We present a new approach for extracting information about cosmic magnetic fields using cross-correlations between extragalactic Faraday rotation measure (RM) catalogs and galaxy surveys. Specifically, we propose measuring the two-point cross-correlation between RM squared, RM 2 {\rm RM}^{2} , towards background sources and the projected density field of foreground galaxies, ⟨ RM 2 × g ⟩ \langle{\rm RM}^{2}\times{\rm g}\rangle , as a function of transverse separation.

pmc-10643079.title: Fournier gangrene in an infant, complicated with severe sepsis and liver dysfunction: A case report
pmc-10643079.creator: Ilirjana Bakalli, Saimir Heta, Ermira Kola, Ermela Celaj
pmc-10643079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Fournier gangrene is a rare, life-threatening infection characterized by necrotizing fasciitis in the perineal, genital and/or lower abdominal regions. Despite its rarity, the unfavorable prognosis associated with this disease is dependent on the timing of medical care.CASE SUMMARYA 3-month-old boy was admitted to our pediatric intensive care unit in critical condition after a 5-day history of fever and scrotal erythema with breaching skin lesions and swelling. Despite ambulatory antibiotic treatment, the child’s clinical condition deteriorated.

pmc-11351126.title: Variation in the Health Status of the Mediterranean Gorgonian Forests: The Synergistic Effect of Marine Heat Waves and Fishing Activity
pmc-11351126.creator: Martina Canessa, Rosella Bertolotto, Federico Betti, Marzia Bo, Alessandro Dagnino, Francesco Enrichetti, Margherita Toma, Giorgio Bavestrello
pmc-11351126.description: Simple SummaryEpibiosis on damaged gorgonians, particularly Paramuricea clavata, is generally used as an indirect indication of stressed conditions. Studying damaged colonies over time can help us understand the temporal evolution of the phenomenon. Positive thermal anomalies recorded before 2019 were identified as the primary cause of damage to gorgonians.

pmc-11443599.title: Effects of a reminiscence therapy-involved program on anxiety, depression, and the quality of life in cancer patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11443599.creator: Xingliang Sun, Wenlian Su, Mengyue Yin, Ling Xia
pmc-11443599.description: ObjectiveReminiscence therapy is increasingly being utilized for cancer patients to address psychological pressure and enhance their quality of life. This meta-analysis aimed to comprehensively evaluate the effect of a reminiscence therapy-involved program (RTIP) on anxiety, depression, and quality of life in cancer patients.

pmc-11492474.title: Inhibiting IL11: a novel approach to turning back the clock
pmc-11492474.creator: Osama Ahmad, Muhammad Haris
pmc-11492474.description: The World Health Organization recognizes frailty and multimorbidity as major global health issues and underscores the need for effective interventions. Recent advances have identified interleukin-11 (IL-11), a pro-inflammatory cytokine, as a key player in modulating aging pathways (such as ERK, AMPK, mTOR and JAK–STAT3).

pmc-11581572.title: Macronutrient and Micronutrient Intake Among US Women Aged 20 to 44 Years
pmc-11581572.creator: Derek Miketinas, Hanqi Luo, Josh A. Firth, Ariana Bailey, Tonya Bender, Gabriele Gross, Lauren Brink
pmc-11581572.description: Key PointsQuestionHow has dietary intake changed over the past 2 decades among pregnant and nonpregnant women in the US?FindingsIn this cross-sectional analysis of 1999-2018 data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, pregnant and nonpregnant women of reproductive age reported consuming less carbohydrates, vitamin A, vitamin C, and iron. Intake of calcium, vitamin K, and magnesium increased over time.

pmc-13121833.title: A Generalized Definition of Multidimensional Item Response Theory Parameters
pmc-13121833.creator: Daniel Morillo-Cuadrado, Mario Luzardo-Verde
pmc-13121833.description: In this paper, we generalize the multidimensional discrimination and difficulty parameters in the multidimensional two-parameter logistic model to account for nonidentity latent covariances and negatively keyed items. We apply Reckase’s maximum discrimination point method to define them in an arbitrary algebraic basis. Then, we define that basis to be a geometrical representation of the measured construct.

pmc-13133104.title: Ground control strategies for longwall top-coal caving panel in extra-thick coal seams with thick-hard roof
pmc-13133104.creator: Rui Wang, Wei-guang Zhang, Hao-sen Wang, Zai-jiang Yu, Qiang Zhang
pmc-13133104.description: Thick-hard roof fracturing presents a significant challenge for disaster prevention in longwall mining. This study investigates the 15,311 south working face and develops a mechanical model to analyze energy release during both initial and cyclic roof fracturing, along with the associated disaster mechanisms.
